question: What fee should the wise withhold from inferiors, and how doubled to convention-holders?
premises: from form-half, the supreme to the inferior should the wise not give fee
to convention-holders, gradually double-double, up to guru-end it would be
inference: Withhold supreme-half fee from inferiors; double it gradually for convention-holders to guru-end.
plain_english: From form-half, supreme — to the inferior should the wise not give fee; to convention-holders, gradually double-double, up to guru-end it would be.
